questions.q: Conference of the Parties, 31st session (COP31), the United Nations (UN) Climate Conference of November 2026, was held in:
questions.explain: Conference of the Parties, 31st session (COP31) ran from 9 to 20 November 2026 in Antalya, Turkiye, with Australia's Chris Bowen overseeing negotiations under a co-presidency arrangement.

questions.q: Who was the President of the Conference of the Parties, 31st session (COP31)?
questions.explain: Turkiye's Environment Minister Murat Kurum presided over Conference of the Parties, 31st session (COP31) at Antalya.

questions.q: India's retail (Consumer Price Index (CPI)) inflation in October 2026, reported in November, rose to:
questions.explain: Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation rose to 6.09% in October 2026 — a 24-month high that breached the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)'s 6% upper tolerance band.

questions.q: Food inflation (CFPI) in India in October 2026 stood at:
questions.explain: Food inflation was 8.94% in October 2026; rural inflation was 6.63% and urban inflation 5.41%.

questions.q: Public sector banks recorded their highest-ever half-year net profit in H1 Financial Year (FY) 2026-27 of about:
questions.explain: Public Sector Banks (PSBs) posted a record H1 net profit of about Rs 1.10 lakh crore, up 16.9%, with aggregate business crossing Rs 300 lakh crore.

questions.q: India's merchandise exports in October 2026 reached a record level of:
questions.explain: Merchandise exports hit a record $49.5 billion in October 2026, rising nearly 30%, while imports also hit a record $89.35 billion.

questions.q: India's merchandise trade deficit in October 2026 widened to a one-year high of:
questions.explain: Record imports of $89.35 billion pushed the October 2026 trade deficit to a one-year high of $39.88 billion.

questions.q: The Union Cabinet extended the Stand-Up India scheme till 31 March 2031 with a credit guarantee corpus of:
questions.explain: Stand-Up India was continued till March 2031 with a Rs 4,111 crore guarantee corpus and a target of 2.5 lakh new entrepreneurs; it funds greenfield loans of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.

questions.q: The Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU), continued till 2031 under PM Mudra Yojana, has a corpus of:
questions.explain: The Cabinet cleared CGFMU's continuation till 31 March 2031 with a Rs 5,000 crore corpus, backing about Rs 12.6 lakh crore of Mudra lending.

questions.q: The Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum, approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) in November 2026, will be built at:
options: The North and South Block complex, New Delhi
questions.explain: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum at the North and South Block complex in New Delhi at an estimated cost of Rs 3,230 crore.

questions.q: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Medical Devices was extended in November 2026 up to:
questions.explain: The Department of Pharmaceuticals extended the medical devices Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme to Financial Year (FY) 2035-36 with an outlay of Rs 2,700 crore.

questions.q: Prime Minister (PM) Modi inaugurated which metro line in Pune on 4 November 2026?
questions.explain: The 23 km Hinjawadi-Shivajinagar Pune Metro Line 3, linking the IT hub to central Pune, was inaugurated on 4 Nov 2026.

questions.q: With the opening of a Pink Line stretch in November 2026, which city's metro network crossed the 100 km mark?
questions.explain: Prime Minister (PM) Modi opened the 7.5 km Kalena Agrahara-Tavarekere stretch of Bengaluru Metro's Pink Line on 13 Nov, taking the network past 100 km.

questions.q: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas, observed on 15 November 2026, marks the birth anniversary of:
questions.explain: 15 November 2026 marked the 151st birth anniversary of Birsa Munda; Prime Minister (PM) Modi launched 246 tribal projects worth about Rs 3,000 crore from Gadchiroli.

questions.q: According to the World Health Organization (WHO) Global Tuberculosis Report 2026, India's Tuberculosis (TB) mortality has declined since 2015 by:
questions.explain: The World Health Organization (WHO) report (12 Nov 2026) recorded a 38% fall in India's Tuberculosis (TB) mortality since 2015, against a global decline of 35%, with a 94% treatment success rate.

questions.q: As per the National Health Accounts 2023-24 released in November 2026, out-of-pocket health spending in India fell to:
questions.explain: Out-of-pocket spending fell from 64.2% in 2013-14 to 42.7%, while government health expenditure rose to Rs 4,14,196 crore.

questions.q: The Consent Manager registration framework that came into effect on 13 November 2026 is part of which Act?
questions.explain: The DPDP Act's Consent Manager framework requires applicants to be Indian companies with a minimum net worth of Rs 2 crore.

questions.q: Exercise Sea Vigil-26, conducted from 11 to 19 November 2026, was the which edition of India's pan-India coastal defence exercise?
questions.explain: Sea Vigil-26, coordinated by the Indian Navy from 11-19 Nov 2026, was the fifth edition of the biennial pan-India coastal defence exercise.

questions.q: Exercise Mitra Shakti 2026, held at Maduru Oya, was a joint military exercise between India and:
questions.explain: The 12th edition of India-Sri Lanka Exercise Mitra Shakti ran from 13 to 26 November 2026 with a 170-member Indian contingent.

questions.q: Exercise Sahayata Setu 2026, a multinational Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) exercise led by the Indian Air Force (IAF), was held at:
questions.explain: Sahayata Setu 2026 was held at AFS Jamnagar, Gujarat, from 17-19 November with representatives from 25 countries.

questions.q: The Rs 1,976.40 crore contract signed on 18 November 2026 to upgrade the Barak-1 missile system was awarded to:
questions.explain: The MoD signed the Rs 1,976.40 crore deal with Israel Aerospace Industries to upgrade the Barak point defence systems on Indian Navy warships.

questions.q: Project 18A, given in-principle approval by the Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) in November 2026, relates to:
options: Stealth frigates of the Nilgiri class
questions.explain: On 2 Nov 2026 the Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) accorded in-principle approval to Project 18A warships — next-generation stealth guided-missile destroyers for the Navy.

questions.q: The fourth India-Japan 2+2 Foreign and Defence Ministerial Dialogue was held in November 2026 in:
questions.explain: The 4th India-Japan 2+2 dialogue was held in Tokyo on 19 Nov 2026; the sides welcomed a letter of intent on Japanese live-fire training at Indian ranges.

questions.q: India was re-elected to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Council for 2027-2030 at the Plenipotentiary Conference held in:
questions.explain: India won re-election to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Council with 151 votes at Doha, finishing third in Region E behind Qatar and Saudi Arabia.

questions.q: Prime Minister (PM) Modi attended the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit in November 2026 in which city?
questions.explain: The 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and 21st East Asia Summit were hosted by Philippine President Marcos Jr. in Manila on 16-17 November 2026.

questions.q: In November 2026, the International Court of Justice ruled that which country committed genocide against the Rohingya?
questions.explain: On 20 Nov 2026 the ICJ ruled Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in Rakhine State — the first such finding against a country under the 1948 Convention.

questions.q: The 2026 Summer Youth Olympic Games were hosted by:
questions.explain: Dakar 2026 (31 Oct-13 Nov) was the fourth Summer Youth Olympics and the first Olympic event ever hosted on the African continent.

questions.q: India's final medal tally at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games was:
questions.explain: India finished 21st with 10 medals — 2 gold, 3 silver, 5 bronze — its second-best Youth Olympics haul after 2018.

questions.q: Lairenlakpam Ambekar Meetei created history at Dakar 2026 by winning India's first-ever Youth Olympics gold in:
questions.explain: Ambekar Meetei of Manipur beat Ireland's Kristian Jubani 3-2 in the men's 50 kg boxing final on 12 Nov — India's first Youth Olympics boxing gold.

questions.q: Gunjan won the women's boxing gold at Dakar 2026 in which category?
questions.explain: Haryana's Gunjan beat Algeria's Bouthaina Bensalah 5-0 in the women's 48 kg final, becoming the first Indian woman to win Youth Olympics boxing gold.

questions.q: At the National Sports Awards 2026 presented on 13 November, which top honour was NOT awarded to anyone this year?
questions.explain: No Khel Ratna was selected in 2026 — the first such instance since 2014; 17 athletes received the Arjuna Award from President Murmu.

questions.q: Who became the first sportsperson from Mizoram to receive the Arjuna Award in 2026?
questions.explain: Hockey player Lalremsiami Hmar became the first sportsperson from Mizoram to receive the Arjuna Award.

questions.q: How many sportspersons received the Arjuna Award at the National Sports Awards 2026?
questions.explain: Seventeen athletes, including Tejaswin Shankar, Divya Deshmukh and Vidit Gujrathi, received the Arjuna Award on 13 Nov 2026.

questions.q: India won the 9th Men's Asian Champions Trophy in hockey in November 2026 by defeating:
questions.explain: India beat Japan 4-1 in the final to lift its 9th Men's Asian Champions Trophy title.

questions.q: Who won the men's singles title at the Hylo Open 2026 badminton tournament?
questions.explain: Lakshya Sen defeated Indonesia's Jonatan Christie to win the Hylo Open 2026 men's singles title on 3 November.

questions.q: India won its 10th South Asian Football Federation (SAFF) football title in November 2026 by beating which team in the final at Dhaka?
questions.explain: India defeated Pakistan in Dhaka to claim its tenth South Asian Football Federation (SAFF) Championship title, as reported on 19 Nov 2026.

questions.q: Who became the Vice Chief of the Air Staff of the Indian Air Force (IAF) on 1 November 2026?
questions.explain: Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia took over as Vice Chief of the Air Staff from 1 Nov 2026, days after Ashutosh Dixit became the Air Chief.

questions.q: Who was re-elected as Chairman of the International Cricket Council (ICC) for a second term in November 2026?
questions.explain: Jay Shah was re-elected International Cricket Council (ICC) Chairman for a second term on 17 November 2026.

questions.q: NASA's Voyager 1 achieved which milestone in November 2026?
options: It crossed the orbit of Neptune again
It became the first human-made object one light-day from Earth
questions.explain: Voyager 1 reached a distance of one light-day from Earth — about 26 billion km — nearly five decades after its launch.

questions.q: National Legal Services Day is observed in India every year on:
questions.explain: National Legal Services Day is observed on 9 November to promote free legal aid awareness; 5 Nov is World Tsunami Awareness Day and 11 Nov is National Education Day.
